description: Low miles and no DEF! 2007 Sprinter, branded as Dodge but is a Mercedes vehicle, 144" WB High Roof Cargo van. The short wheelbase makes it easy to maneuver in parking lots and fit in one parking spot while the tall roof allows you to stand up inside without bending over. I have owned this vehicle since new and have taken good care of it, inside, outside, and mechanically. The cargo area is outfitted with a flat floor and adjustable shelving, great for organizing and storing all your tools or equipment. There is a bulkhead/partition between the cab and cargo area for safety with a passthrough door. This van also features a rear equipment lift rated at 1100 pounds, that folds into the inside of the back doors when not in use. The hydraulic pump is powered by an auxiliary battery so the engine does not need to be running to operate the lift. Also tied to that battery are two work lights on the ceiling to make sure you can see everything in the cargo area. The exterior of the van was repainted approximately 10 years ago, and the paint is still glossy with a few small areas that have a little damage, shown in the pictures. The tires are ~2 years old with ~75% of their treadwear left. The cab shows the normal wear you would expect for a vehicle of this age and mileage. The cloth of both seats are in good shape with no tears. The seatbelt retractor on the drivers side is getting weak, but still rolls the belt up most of the way. The instrument panel and radio are clean and functional with no issues. Overall this is a very clean and mechanically sound van that is ready for its second life as your work truck or whatever your imagination can dream up!

The 2011 Toyota Corolla is a reliable and efficient vehicle that stands out in its class. While it may not come with any specific packages, its top features make it an excellent choice for both daily commuting and road trips.

One of the most notable features is **Brake Assist**, which enhances your stopping power in emergency situations. This feature utilizes the speed of the brake pedals travel to detect panic braking and applies maximum power to ensure you stop safely, helping to prevent accidents before they happen.

Another impressive attribute is the **Cruise Control** system that provides ease during long drives. By setting your desired speed, you can minimize driver fatigue and improve fuel economy, making your road trips less stressful and more enjoyable.

The 2011 Toyota Corolla also boasts **Variable Valve Timing**, which optimizes engine performance at both low and high RPMs, resulting in improved fuel efficiency and cleaner emissions. Coupled with its **Inline 4-Cylinder Engine**, the Corolla offers adequate horsepower while ensuring better fuel economy and lower maintenance costs compared to larger engines.

The **DOHC Dual Overhead Cam** design enhances performance, allowing for a higher speed and more power than standard engines. This means you can reach your destinations faster without compromising on efficiency. Additionally, the **Sequential Multi-Point Electronic Fuel Injection** system contributes to better combustion efficiency, leading to cleaner emissions and improved performance across various weather conditions.

Security is also prioritized in the 2011 Corolla with features like the **Ignition Immobilizer**, which uses a transmitter in the key and a sensor in the vehicle to prevent unauthorized starts, helping you feel more secure about your vehicle.

Furthermore, the **Electronic Stability Control** system helps maintain traction by monitoring vehicle dynamics and adjusting various systems to prevent skidding, allowing you to stay grounded on the road.

For families, the **Manual Rear Child Safety Locks** provide peace of mind by preventing rear doors from being opened from the inside, ensuring that children remain safe during travel.

Finally, the **Heated Side Door Mirrors** are a thoughtful touch, offering better visibility in cold conditions by quickly clearing frost and ice.

In conclusion, the 2011 Toyota Corolla is a practical choice for those seeking a dependable vehicle with a strong emphasis on safety, efficiency, and convenience.

Hey there!

I'm selling my 2016 Scion (Toyota) IA. Please do check out the online reviews, as these are great cars!!!

If you're unfamiliar with Scion, it was a brief partnership between Mazda and Toyota. This car is really just a budget Mazda that was released in the US under the Toyota brand Scion. (The registration lists this car as a Toyota, and the motor bears the Toyota logo.) You can take this car to any Toyota dealer for service/parts if you like. The 2017 version of this car looks identical to the 2016 but was released as the Toyota Yaris IA.

Despite the high mileage (163.5k), there are no motor issues! I get about 30 mpg since I mostly do neighborhood/city driving, but it will go all the way up to 32 mpg if you do a lot of highway driving. It takes 87 gasoline.

EVERYTHING still works e.g., the Bluetooth, the reverse camera, the AC, the radio, etc. All of the parts are original no aftermarket additions/modifications.

I'm listing this a tad higher than the KBB suggested value since I put on all new tires in mid-January. As you'd expect, there are some minor scratches on the exterior and visible wear on the seats, but this car really is in fantastic shape. It's an absolute gem and I wish I didn't have to sell it. I have both of the original key fobs and they both still work.

All of the photos in this listing were taken on March 16. This particular red definitely isn't a bright red. Sometimes it looks maroon while other times it looks like a rusty red, depending on the light.

Let me know if you'd like to come take a look!

Dealers selling comparable year & mileage for $6k-$10k!!

Ownership history:
Owned by California municipal at 52k miles
CA municipal sold it at auction to get a new fleet
I bought it for my son Anthony on his 16th bday
Anthony sold it back to me when he went to college.
I sold it to my younger son Shawn. And now he wants to upgrade.

The pics are when I bought it. Since then, there are minor cosmetic defects. A few tiny door dings, and a few very small patches of missing paint. Overall it's clean yet it could use a fresh interior detail.

Disclosure: The catalytic converter was stolen before I bought the car and the dealer didn't disclose that to me.
A red light came on, so I took it to the Toyota dealership. The Toyota mechanic looked over the car and said it's not an issue. (The catalytic converter is for emissions purposes and FL doesn't test for that.). He said the car seems to be fine and should continue to run great.

We replaced the ignition coils recently for $195 and new tires $250.

We replaced the battery 3 years ago. Since then the battery hasn't started 2X, so I recommend keeping a pair of battery jumpers on hand. You can get one for under $100 that is rechargeable, no cables or donor car needed. One trick I learned is that after it happens if you clean the battery terminals, trickle charge the battery, and that seems do the trick. Trickle chargers are cheap, like $30.

Text Shawn to see it, test drive it.

This 2021 Kia K5 LXS is a sophisticated midsize sedan that balances efficiency with performance. Under the hood, it is powered by a dynamic 1.6L Turbo GDI I-4 cylinder engine, ensuring a responsive driving experience. This engine is paired with a smooth-shifting 8-speed automatic transmission , which optimizes power delivery to the Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) system.

The vehicle is engineered for impressive fuel economy, boasting an estimated 27 MPG in the city and 37 MPG on the highway, making it an excellent choice for both urban commuting and long-distance travel. The ride quality is supported by a suspension system designed for stability, while the Variable Intermittent Wipers and compact spare tire mounted inside under the cargo area add layers of practicality and peace of mind for daily driving.

Exterior Styling and Features
The exterior of this K5 LXS is finished in a commanding Ebony Black paint, a color that perfectly accentuates the sedan's sleek lines and aggressive stance. The body features fully galvanized steel panels and is adorned with a metal-look grille that adds a touch of premium elegance to the front fascia.

Lighting is a standout feature on this model. It comes equipped with Auto On/Off Aero-Composite LED low and high beam daytime running headlamps with delay-off functionality. Additionally, the vehicle features automatic high beams and perimeter/approach lights, ensuring excellent visibility in various lighting conditions.

The side profile is defined by body-colored power heated side mirrors with manual folding capability , body-colored door handles , and chrome side window trim that complements the black front windshield trim and chrome rear window trim. The vehicle rolls on stylish 16-inch machined finish alloy wheels (6.5J x 16") , wrapped in P205/65R16 tires, providing a solid grip and a comfortable ride. The rear of the vehicle includes a fixed rear window with a defroster and a body-colored rear bumper with a chrome bumper insert, tying together the cohesive design.

Inside the cabin, the vehicle features a Sand interior with cloth seat trim, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The front cabin offers front bucket seats with a front center armrest , while the rear passengers benefit from a rear center armrest and spacious seating. The interior is designed for convenience, featuring a full carpet floor covering , carpet floor trim , and cargo space lights to illuminate the trunk area.

Technological amenities include an AM/FM/MP3 audio system and a redundant digital speedometer for clear information display at a glance. The driver is further supported by a systems monitor , an outside temperature gauge , and a driver information center. For added comfort, the cabin includes air filtration and delayed accessory power. Storage solutions are plentiful, with driver and passenger door bins , rear door bins , and two seatback storage pockets.

Safety and Driver Assistance
Safety is a major highlight of this K5 LXS, which is packed with advanced driver-assistance systems. Standout safety features include:


Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist (FCA): Helps detect potential collisions and can apply brakes to mitigate accidents.

Blind-Spot Collision Warning: Alerts the driver to vehicles in blind spots, enhancing safety during lane changes.

Rear Cross-Traffic Collision Avoidance-Assist (RCCA): Detects approaching traffic from the sides when backing up.

Lane Safety and Driver Monitoring: Includes Driver Monitoring-Alert to detect fatigue and Collision Mitigation-Front.
Rear View Monitor with Parking Guidance: Provides a clear view of the area behind the vehicle with guidance lines to assist in parking.
